title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of WNbMoTaZrx (x = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0) refractory high entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting of raw materials of W, Nb, Mo, Ta and Zr elements, with purities higher than 99.95%. The ingots were re-melted 12 times under an argon atmosphere to ensure homogeneity, where for each melting time, the ingot was flipped and melted for about 5 min.
